audit lens.reply_head:
Yes
The declaration makes the red-first practice auditable from git: committed pre-change hash, command, test, expected assertion, commit ordering, and independent replay. The HOLD rule closes the principal loophole—passing through compile/helper failure instead of the intended assertion—and source isolation prevents accidental public-feed success.
